canonical_claim.raw_claim_text: 1. A coated silicone hydrogel contact lens, comprising: a silicone hydrogel contact lens and a non-silicone hydrogel coating thereon, wherein the non-silicone hydrogel coating is composed of a crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material which comprises from about 20% to about 95% by weight of first polymer chains derived from a multi-arm polyethyleneglycol having terminal epoxide groups and from about 5% to about 80% by weight of a second polymer chains derived from at least one hydrophilicity-enhancing agent, wherein said at least one hydrophilicity-enhancing agent is selected from the group consisting of: PEG-NH 2 ; PEG-SH; PEG-COOH; H 2 N-PEG-NH 2 ; HOOC-PEG-COOH; HS-PEG-SH; H 2 N-PEG-COOH; HOOC-PEG-SH; H 2 N-PEG-SH: multi-arm PEG with at least one amino group; multi-arm PEG with at least one carboxyl group; multi-arm PEG with at least one thiol group; PEG dendrimers with at least one amino group; PEG dendrimers with at least one carboxyl group; PEG dendrimers with at least one thiol group; and combinations thereof, wherein the coated silicone hydrogel contact lens has at least one of the properties selected from the group consisting of: an oxygen permeability of at least about 40 barrers; an elastic modulus of about 1.5 MPa or less; an Ionoflux Diffusion Coefficient, D, of, at least about 1.5×10 −6 mm 2 /min; a water content of from about 18% to about 70% by weight when fully hydrated; or combinations thereof. || 2. novelty_results.rationale: The prior-art patent discloses a coated silicone hydrogel contact lens (L1) with a non-silicone hydrogel coating (L3). However, it does not disclose the specific composition of the coating (L2), which is required to be within a specific weight range of first and second polymer chains. Therefore, the prior-art patent does not anticipate the claim under test.

obviousness_result.closest_prior_art_rationale: Selected as closest prior art because it discloses 2 limitations. It is in a closely related technical field.
obviousness_result.objective_technical_problem: Improving the durability and stability of the non-silicone hydrogel coating on a silicone hydrogel contact lens, particularly in terms of preventing the degradation of the coating over time.
obviousness_result.motivation: The motivation to combine the closest prior art with a secondary reference is to improve the durability and stability of the non-silicone hydrogel coating on a silicone hydrogel contact lens.
obviousness_result.motivation_evidence: The closest prior art does not provide a clear motivation to combine with a secondary reference, as it only addresses limitations L1 and L3.

technical_effects.feature: The use of a crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material composed of multi-arm polyethyleneglycol and hydrophilicity-enhancing agents.
technical_effects.effect_description: Improves the durability and stability of the non-silicone hydrogel coating on a silicone hydrogel contact lens.

obviousness_result.expectation_evidence: A person skilled in the art may expect some success in improving the durability and stability of the non-silicone hydrogel coating, but the specific solution of using a crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material composed of multi-arm polyethyleneglycol and hydrophilicity-enhancing agents is not obvious.
obviousness_result.teaching_away_evidence: The closest prior art does not teach away from the claimed invention, as it only addresses limitations L1 and L3.
obviousness_result.could_rationale: A person skilled in the art would not naturally try to combine the closest prior art with a secondary reference to improve the durability and stability of the non-silicone hydrogel coating on a silicone hydrogel contact lens.
obviousness_result.would_rationale: A person skilled in the art would not be motivated to combine the closest prior art with a secondary reference to improve the durability and stability of the non-silicone hydrogel coating on a silicone hydrogel contact lens.
obviousness_result.why_explanation: The claimed invention is not obvious because it requires a non-obvious combination of the closest prior art with a secondary reference, and the specific solution of using a crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material composed of multi-arm polyethyleneglycol and hydrophilicity-enhancing agents is not obvious.

combination_matrix.motivation_to_combine: Improving the durability and stability of the non-silicone hydrogel coating on a silicone hydrogel contact lens.
combination_matrix.expected_benefit: Improving the durability and stability of the non-silicone hydrogel coating on a silicone hydrogel contact lens.

obviousness_result.pass_a_pre_disclosure_solution: A person skilled in the art would naturally try to address the limitation L1 by developing a non-silicone hydrogel coating that is more resistant to degradation, and address the limitation L3 by improving the adhesion of the coating to the silicone hydrogel contact lens, without necessarily considering the specific solution of using a crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material composed of multi-arm polyethyleneglycol and hydrophilicity-enhancing agents.
obviousness_result.pass_b_post_disclosure_comparison: The claimed invention is more complex than the closest prior art, and the specific solution of using a crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material composed of multi-arm polyethyleneglycol and hydrophilicity-enhancing agents is not obvious.

obviousness_result.determination_rationale: The claimed invention is not obvious because it requires a non-obvious combination of the closest prior art with a secondary reference, and the specific solution of using a crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material composed of multi-arm polyethyleneglycol and hydrophilicity-enhancing agents is not obvious.
